title: Design direction guidance
description: Advisory design heuristics for agents and reviewers: operating rules for UI work and signals of generic or low-quality interfaces. They never produce findings; reviewers raise REVIEW items from them.

rules.title: One primary task per view

params.guidance: Define one primary task for each view or functional region, and name the action and content that make it possible.

rules.message: Design guidance: one primary task per view.
rules.fix: Define one primary task for each view or functional region, and name the action and content that make it possible.
rules.rationale: Operating rule for UI work; a heuristic, not a measured threshold.

rules.title: Hierarchy before decoration

params.guidance: Build hierarchy with size, weight, position and space before adding decoration. Title, content and call to action must have distinguishable priorities.

rules.message: Design guidance: hierarchy before decoration.
rules.fix: Build hierarchy with size, weight, position and space before adding decoration. Title, content and call to action must have distinguishable priorities.
rules.rationale: Operating rule for UI work; a heuristic, not a measured threshold.

rules.title: Group by proximity

params.guidance: Group related items by proximity and separate groups by more space than the items inside a group. Document the inner and outer gaps.

rules.message: Design guidance: group by proximity.
rules.fix: Group related items by proximity and separate groups by more space than the items inside a group. Document the inner and outer gaps.
rules.rationale: Operating rule for UI work; a heuristic, not a measured threshold.

rules.title: Shared alignment anchors

params.guidance: Align blocks to common anchors and justify local optical deviations. Measure the grid and the boxes.

rules.message: Design guidance: shared alignment anchors.
rules.fix: Align blocks to common anchors and justify local optical deviations. Measure the grid and the boxes.
rules.rationale: Operating rule for UI work; a heuristic, not a measured threshold.

rules.title: Repetition for sameness, contrast for difference

params.guidance: Give the same role the same treatment and use contrast for important differences. Explain every exception.

rules.message: Design guidance: repetition for sameness, contrast for difference.
rules.fix: Give the same role the same treatment and use contrast for important differences. Explain every exception.
rules.rationale: Operating rule for UI work; a heuristic, not a measured threshold.

rules.title: One body family

params.guidance: Pick one body typeface and add another only when it has a distinct role. Define fonts, weights, licences and roles.

rules.message: Design guidance: one body family.
rules.fix: Pick one body typeface and add another only when it has a distinct role. Define fonts, weights, licences and roles.
rules.rationale: Operating rule for UI work; a heuristic, not a measured threshold.

rules.title: Typography with real content

params.guidance: Design typography with real content, including numbers and long text. Review reading, wrapping and fallbacks.

rules.message: Design guidance: typography with real content.
rules.fix: Design typography with real content, including numbers and long text. Review reading, wrapping and fallbacks.
rules.rationale: Operating rule for UI work; a heuristic, not a measured threshold.

rules.title: Emphasis for progress

params.guidance: Reserve the strongest emphasis for what lets the user advance in the task. Secondary actions must not compete without a reason.

rules.message: Design guidance: emphasis for progress.
rules.fix: Reserve the strongest emphasis for what lets the user advance in the task. Secondary actions must not compete without a reason.
rules.rationale: Operating rule for UI work; a heuristic, not a measured threshold.

rules.title: Semantic palette with validated pairs

params.guidance: Use a semantic palette and validate every permitted foreground and background pair against the contrast graph.

rules.message: Design guidance: semantic palette with validated pairs.
rules.fix: Use a semantic palette and validate every permitted foreground and background pair against the contrast graph.
rules.rationale: Operating rule for UI work; a heuristic, not a measured threshold.

rules.title: Structure and space before boxes

params.guidance: Prefer structure and space to group content; add a box, border or shadow only when it explains a relationship. Every container needs a purpose.

rules.message: Design guidance: structure and space before boxes.
rules.fix: Prefer structure and space to group content; add a box, border or shadow only when it explains a relationship. Every container needs a purpose.
rules.rationale: Operating rule for UI work; a heuristic, not a measured threshold.

rules.title: Consistent radii, strokes, icons and elevation

params.guidance: Keep radii, stroke widths, icons and elevations consistent through shared tokens and variants.

rules.message: Design guidance: consistent radii, strokes, icons and elevation.
rules.fix: Keep radii, stroke widths, icons and elevations consistent through shared tokens and variants.
rules.rationale: Operating rule for UI work; a heuristic, not a measured threshold.

rules.title: Density follows frequency and experience

params.guidance: Match density to how often and how expertly the interface is used: a frequent operator may need more information on screen.

rules.message: Design guidance: density follows frequency and experience.
rules.fix: Match density to how often and how expertly the interface is used: a frequent operator may need more information on screen.
rules.rationale: Operating rule for UI work; a heuristic, not a measured threshold.

rules.title: Specific actions and recoverable errors

params.guidance: Write specific action labels and errors that offer a way to recover: the action ("Save changes"), the reason for a failure and the next step.

rules.message: Design guidance: specific actions and recoverable errors.
rules.fix: Write specific action labels and errors that offer a way to recover: the action ("Save changes"), the reason for a failure and the next step.
rules.rationale: Operating rule for UI work; a heuristic, not a measured threshold.

rules.title: Authentic imagery with intentional cropping

params.guidance: Use authentic or clearly illustrative images with an intentional crop. Record the asset, aspect ratio, focal point and accessible alternative.

rules.message: Design guidance: authentic imagery with intentional cropping.
rules.fix: Use authentic or clearly illustrative images with an intentional crop. Record the asset, aspect ratio, focal point and accessible alternative.
rules.rationale: Operating rule for UI work; a heuristic, not a measured threshold.

rules.title: Motion that explains

params.guidance: Use motion to explain a response or a relationship, and respect reduced-motion preferences. Give each transition a purpose, a final state and an alternative.

rules.message: Design guidance: motion that explains.
rules.fix: Use motion to explain a response or a relationship, and respect reduced-motion preferences. Give each transition a purpose, a final state and an alternative.
rules.rationale: Operating rule for UI work; a heuristic, not a measured threshold.

rules.title: Responsive composition keeps priorities

params.guidance: Adapt the composition by width while keeping priorities and reading order; do not shrink everything proportionally.

rules.message: Design guidance: responsive composition keeps priorities.
rules.fix: Adapt the composition by width while keeping priorities and reading order; do not shrink everything proportionally.
rules.rationale: Operating rule for UI work; a heuristic, not a measured threshold.

rules.title: Equal care for every state

params.guidance: Design loading, empty, error and success states with the same care as the normal state, using a state matrix with content.

rules.message: Design guidance: equal care for every state.
rules.fix: Design loading, empty, error and success states with the same care as the normal state, using a state matrix with content.
rules.rationale: Operating rule for UI work; a heuristic, not a measured threshold.

rules.title: Finish when the contract is met

params.guidance: Stop when the contract is satisfied and no relevant defect remains. Report the evidence and the remaining differences instead of polishing endlessly.

rules.message: Design guidance: finish when the contract is met.
rules.fix: Stop when the contract is satisfied and no relevant defect remains. Report the evidence and the remaining differences instead of polishing endlessly.
rules.rationale: Operating rule for UI work; a heuristic, not a measured threshold.

rules.title: Interchangeable composition

params.guidance: Interchangeable composition. Why it can weaken the interface: The content is squeezed into a template and the task loses priority. Recommended correction: Choose the structure by task; keep a conventional pattern when it works. Treat it as a REVIEW signal, not a failure, unless it violates the brief, authorised content or a functional or accessibility criterion.

rules.message: Design review signal: interchangeable composition.
rules.fix: Choose the structure by task; keep a conventional pattern when it works.
rules.rationale: The content is squeezed into a template and the task loses priority.

rules.title: Marketing hero inside a tool

params.guidance: Marketing hero inside a tool. Why it can weaken the interface: A huge heading delays reaching the work. Recommended correction: Use a compact header with the action visible; reserve a hero for an offer or an experience. Treat it as a REVIEW signal, not a failure, unless it violates the brief, authorised content or a functional or accessibility criterion.

rules.message: Design review signal: marketing hero inside a tool.
rules.fix: Use a compact header with the action visible; reserve a hero for an offer or an experience.
rules.rationale: A huge heading delays reaching the work.

rules.title: Every datum in a card

params.guidance: Every datum in a card. Why it can weaken the interface: Cards fragment reading and make attribute comparison hard. Recommended correction: Use a table, a list or relation groups; keep cards for independent units. Treat it as a REVIEW signal, not a failure, unless it violates the brief, authorised content or a functional or accessibility criterion.

rules.message: Design review signal: every datum in a card.
rules.fix: Use a table, a list or relation groups; keep cards for independent units.
rules.rationale: Cards fragment reading and make attribute comparison hard.

rules.title: Nested decorative containers

params.guidance: Nested decorative containers. Why it can weaken the interface: Borders, shadows and padding consume space without clarifying structure. Recommended correction: Flatten the grouping; keep functional nesting such as a panel with controls. Treat it as a REVIEW signal, not a failure, unless it violates the brief, authorised content or a functional or accessibility criterion.

rules.message: Design review signal: nested decorative containers.
rules.fix: Flatten the grouping; keep functional nesting such as a panel with controls.
rules.rationale: Borders, shadows and padding consume space without clarifying structure.

rules.title: Ornaments louder than the task

params.guidance: Ornaments louder than the task. Why it can weaken the interface: Attention goes to effects rather than decisions. Recommended correction: Reduce effects or give them a purpose and a bounded area. Treat it as a REVIEW signal, not a failure, unless it violates the brief, authorised content or a functional or accessibility criterion.

rules.message: Design review signal: ornaments louder than the task.
rules.fix: Reduce effects or give them a purpose and a bounded area.
rules.rationale: Attention goes to effects rather than decisions.

rules.title: Everything equally prominent

params.guidance: Everything equally prominent. Why it can weaken the interface: Nothing says what to do first. Recommended correction: Define an attention order with differences in size, weight, space or colour. Treat it as a REVIEW signal, not a failure, unless it violates the brief, authorised content or a functional or accessibility criterion.

rules.message: Design review signal: everything equally prominent.
rules.fix: Define an attention order with differences in size, weight, space or colour.
rules.rationale: Nothing says what to do first.

rules.title: Palette chosen by reflex

params.guidance: Palette chosen by reflex. Why it can weaken the interface: The brand could belong to any product. Recommended correction: Justify families by identity and roles; do not change an approved palette because of fashion. Treat it as a REVIEW signal, not a failure, unless it violates the brief, authorised content or a functional or accessibility criterion.

rules.message: Design review signal: palette chosen by reflex.
rules.fix: Justify families by identity and roles; do not change an approved palette because of fashion.
rules.rationale: The brand could belong to any product.

rules.title: Elegance through faint text

params.guidance: Elegance through faint text. Why it can weaken the interface: Readability is sacrificed to soften the screenshot. Recommended correction: Keep contrast and legibility; check real backgrounds and states. Treat it as a REVIEW signal, not a failure, unless it violates the brief, authorised content or a functional or accessibility criterion.

rules.message: Design review signal: elegance through faint text.
rules.fix: Keep contrast and legibility; check real backgrounds and states.
rules.rationale: Readability is sacrificed to soften the screenshot.

rules.title: Typography without criteria or substituted

params.guidance: Typography without criteria or substituted. Why it can weaken the interface: Tone, metrics, line breaks and density change. Recommended correction: Load the approved family and real weights and define roles; do not ban a font only because it is common. Treat it as a REVIEW signal, not a failure, unless it violates the brief, authorised content or a functional or accessibility criterion.

rules.message: Design review signal: typography without criteria or substituted.
rules.fix: Load the approved family and real weights and define roles; do not ban a font only because it is common.
rules.rationale: Tone, metrics, line breaks and density change.

rules.title: Large headings with extreme tracking

params.guidance: Large headings with extreme tracking. Why it can weaken the interface: The graphic effect reduces legibility or breaks on mobile. Recommended correction: Tune by typeface, length and viewport; use expressive display type only where it fits. Treat it as a REVIEW signal, not a failure, unless it violates the brief, authorised content or a functional or accessibility criterion.

rules.message: Design review signal: large headings with extreme tracking.
rules.fix: Tune by typeface, length and viewport; use expressive display type only where it fits.
rules.rationale: The graphic effect reduces legibility or breaks on mobile.

rules.title: Every control looks like a chip

params.guidance: Every control looks like a chip. Why it can weaken the interface: Buttons, filters, tags and states become confusable. Recommended correction: Differentiate appearance by behaviour; give equal functions equal shapes. Treat it as a REVIEW signal, not a failure, unless it violates the brief, authorised content or a functional or accessibility criterion.

rules.message: Design review signal: every control looks like a chip.
rules.fix: Differentiate appearance by behaviour; give equal functions equal shapes.
rules.rationale: Buttons, filters, tags and states become confusable.

rules.title: Mixed or oversized icons

params.guidance: Mixed or oversized icons. Why it can weaken the interface: Stylistic noise and visual weight without value. Recommended correction: Use one family, scale and stroke; add icons only when they help recognition. Treat it as a REVIEW signal, not a failure, unless it violates the brief, authorised content or a functional or accessibility criterion.

rules.message: Design review signal: mixed or oversized icons.
rules.fix: Use one family, scale and stroke; add icons only when they help recognition.
rules.rationale: Stylistic noise and visual weight without value.

rules.title: Filler image or stereotyped metaphor

params.guidance: Filler image or stereotyped metaphor. Why it can weaken the interface: It occupies space without showing the product or information. Recommended correction: Use specific content; decoration may set a tone if it does not interfere. Treat it as a REVIEW signal, not a failure, unless it violates the brief, authorised content or a functional or accessibility criterion.

rules.message: Design review signal: filler image or stereotyped metaphor.
rules.fix: Use specific content; decoration may set a tone if it does not interfere.
rules.rationale: It occupies space without showing the product or information.

rules.title: Generic or repeated copy

params.guidance: Generic or repeated copy. Why it can weaken the interface: It adds reading without clarifying benefit or action. Recommended correction: Use concrete task language and contextual help where it removes doubt. Treat it as a REVIEW signal, not a failure, unless it violates the brief, authorised content or a functional or accessibility criterion.

rules.message: Design review signal: generic or repeated copy.
rules.fix: Use concrete task language and contextual help where it removes doubt.
rules.rationale: It adds reading without clarifying benefit or action.

rules.title: Invented figures, clients or testimonials

params.guidance: Invented figures, clients or testimonials. Why it can weaken the interface: The screen suggests facts that nothing supports. Recommended correction: A failure when presented as real; use verified content or an identified demo. Treat it as a REVIEW signal, not a failure, unless it violates the brief, authorised content or a functional or accessibility criterion.

rules.message: Design review signal: invented figures, clients or testimonials.
rules.fix: A failure when presented as real; use verified content or an identified demo.
rules.rationale: The screen suggests facts that nothing supports.

rules.title: Uniform spacing for different relations

params.guidance: Uniform spacing for different relations. Why it can weaken the interface: The grouping between title, help, fields and sections is lost. Recommended correction: Use less distance inside a group and more between groups; respect the system. Treat it as a REVIEW signal, not a failure, unless it violates the brief, authorised content or a functional or accessibility criterion.

rules.message: Design review signal: uniform spacing for different relations.
rules.fix: Use less distance inside a group and more between groups; respect the system.
rules.rationale: The grouping between title, help, fields and sections is lost.

rules.title: Excess emptiness to look sophisticated

params.guidance: Excess emptiness to look sophisticated. Why it can weaken the interface: Data is scattered and the user scrolls for no benefit. Recommended correction: Match density to the user; use deliberate space in editorial or brand contexts. Treat it as a REVIEW signal, not a failure, unless it violates the brief, authorised content or a functional or accessibility criterion.

rules.message: Design review signal: excess emptiness to look sophisticated.
rules.fix: Match density to the user; use deliberate space in editorial or brand contexts.
rules.rationale: Data is scattered and the user scrolls for no benefit.

rules.title: Continuous motion without meaning

params.guidance: Continuous motion without meaning. Why it can weaken the interface: It competes for attention and can hinder use. Recommended correction: Signal relevant changes; respect user preferences and motion criteria. Treat it as a REVIEW signal, not a failure, unless it violates the brief, authorised content or a functional or accessibility criterion.

rules.message: Design review signal: continuous motion without meaning.
rules.fix: Signal relevant changes; respect user preferences and motion criteria.
rules.rationale: It competes for attention and can hinder use.

rules.title: Humanising with random imperfections

params.guidance: Humanising with random imperfections. Why it can weaken the interface: Misalignments and variations damage consistency. Recommended correction: Express personality through content and direction; allow irregularity only in authorised assets. Treat it as a REVIEW signal, not a failure, unless it violates the brief, authorised content or a functional or accessibility criterion.

rules.message: Design review signal: humanising with random imperfections.
rules.fix: Express personality through content and direction; allow irregularity only in authorised assets.
rules.rationale: Misalignments and variations damage consistency.

rules.title: Swapping one cliche for another

params.guidance: Swapping one cliche for another. Why it can weaken the interface: Beige, serif or brutalism can become another automatic template. Recommended correction: Choose from the brief, not in opposition to a list of banned styles. Treat it as a REVIEW signal, not a failure, unless it violates the brief, authorised content or a functional or accessibility criterion.

rules.message: Design review signal: swapping one cliche for another.
rules.fix: Choose from the brief, not in opposition to a list of banned styles.
rules.rationale: Beige, serif or brutalism can become another automatic template.
